name: sum-two-counters
comment: Runtime parity only - NOT a merge rule to copy. Both engines must compute base + both deltas alike, but as an in-merge resolver this is the documented anti-pattern (spec §12.4.1, user guide 'What a merge-time procedure can rely on'): a merge never offers a document both sides hold with the same value, base may be a stale common ancestor, and results feed later merges, so increments are lost or counted twice. per-node-counter-max.json is the counter to use.
